clauses.clause: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
clauses.evidence: a 1-power creature never has excess over a live blocker on the standard board. Covered by pack swiftblade_vindicator_trample_excess.json (Giant Growth -> 4/4, blocked by a 2/2: first-strike step asks the trample split 0..2 and deals 2 to the blocker + 2 to the opponent, regular step 4 more: opponent 20 -> 14) PASS. Pack swiftblade_vindicator_trample.json (1/1 chump-blocked: first strike kills the blocker, regular damage 1 to the opponent) PASS, but it cannot isolate trample because of the engine bug below.
clauses.issue: ENGINE BUG seen while building the pack (not this card's tree): MTG_bot/core/executor/__init__.py:1974, _assign_damage 'if not blockers: return ((power, attacked),)' - a BLOCKED attacker whose blockers have all left combat assigns its full damage to the defending player even WITHOUT trample (control: Drogskol Reaver, no trample, blocked by Thornweald Archer: the Archer dies to first-strike damage and the Reaver then deals 3 to the player, 20 -> 17). CR 510.1c: such a creature assigns no combat damage unless it has trample (CR 702.19e) or an as-though-unblocked effect. Every first/double striker without trample (and any attacker whose blocker is removed after blocks) is stronger than printed.
